title_zh: 说明牙痛并确认牙医预约

scenario.goal_zh: 描述疼痛持续情况并确认可到诊时间

context_zh: 虚构就诊沟通练习：比安卡因持续牙痛致电牙科前台，描述相关不适并预约检查。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Bianca
sentences.text: I've had toothache since Sunday, and there's an unpleasant taste in my mouth. Could I see a dentist?

sentences.speaker: Dental Receptionist
sentences.text: We have an appointment at ten thirty tomorrow. Can you tell me which side hurts?

sentences.speaker: Bianca
sentences.text: The lower left. I'm unable to chew on that side, and my tongue keeps catching on a rough edge.

sentences.speaker: Dental Receptionist
sentences.text: I'll add that to your notes. Does tomorrow morning work for you?

sentences.speaker: Bianca
sentences.text: Yes. Will the dentist be able to treat it at that appointment?

sentences.speaker: Dental Receptionist
sentences.text: They'll examine you first and explain what can be done. I can't promise a particular treatment in advance.

sentences.speaker: Bianca
sentences.text: I understand. Please book me in for ten thirty tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: Dental Receptionist
sentences.text: That's booked. Please come to reception when you arrive.
